tools.name: DATA_createAdvancedAudit
tools.title: Create Advanced Audit
tools.description: Data Tool: Launches an advanced website audit that renders JavaScript before analyzing the page. Use for Single-Page Applications (SPAs) or dynamic content. For static or server-side-rendered sites, use createStandardAudit instead.

title.description: Custom title for the audit report. Maximum 300 characters.

source_site.description: Scan all pages by following internal links from the homepage. 0=no, 1=yes. Default: 1.

source_subdomain.description: Scan subdomains. If 0, subdomain links are treated as external. Default: 0.

source_file.description: Use a custom list of pages for the audit. 0=no, 1=yes. Default: 0.

ignore_noindex.description: Ignore pages with a noindex tag. 0=no, 1=yes. Default: 0.

ignore_nofollow.description: Ignore links with a nofollow attribute. 0=no, 1=yes. Default: 0.

ignore_params.description: Ignore URL parameters. 0=none, 1=all, 2=custom list (see custom_params). Default: 0.

custom_params.description: Comma-separated list of URL parameters to ignore when ignore_params is 2.

user_agent.description: User-Agent for crawl. 0=SE Ranking bot, 1=Googlebot, 7=Chrome Windows, etc. Default: 0.

max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl. Default: 1000.

max_size.description: Maximum page size in kilobytes. Default: 3000.

min_title_len.description: Minimum length for the <title> tag. Default: 20.

max_title_len.description: Maximum length for the <title> tag. Default: 65.

min_description_len.description: Minimum length for the meta description. Default: 1.

max_description_len.description: Maximum length for the meta description. Default: 158.

min_words.description: Minimum word count per page. Default: 250.

allow.description: Only crawl URLs that start with these paths. Newline-separated. Empty string clears the list.

disallow.description: Do not crawl URLs that start with these paths. Newline-separated. Empty string clears the list.

disallow_ext.description: External URLs or domains to ignore when checking outbound links. Newline-separated (e.g. "cdn.example.com\nhttps://tracking.example.com/pixel").

hide.description: Hide URLs and resources starting with these paths from the report. Newline-separated.

disabled_issues.description: Array of issue codes to disable for this audit (e.g. ["title_long","image_no_alt"]). Issue codes match those returned by DATA_getAuditReport under sections[].props[].code.

send_report.description: Send an email report when the audit completes. 0=no, 1=yes. Default: 1.

report_email.description: Single email address for the audit report (legacy). Prefer report_emails.

report_emails.description: Comma-separated list of email addresses for the audit report.

settings.description: Object containing specific audit settings. Only include parameters you want to override.

user_agent.description: User-Agent for crawl. 0=SE Ranking bot, 1=Googlebot, 7=Chrome Windows, etc. Default: 0.

max_title_len.description: Maximum length for the <title> tag. Default: 65.

min_description_len.description: Minimum length for the meta description. Default: 1.

max_description_len.description: Maximum length for the meta description. Default: 158.

min_words.description: Minimum word count per page. Default: 250.

allow.description: Only crawl URLs that start with these paths. Newline-separated. Empty string clears the list.

audit_id.description: Unique identifier of the audit to delete.

tools.name: DATA_exportBacklinksData
tools.title: Export Backlinks Data
tools.description: Data Tool: Starts an asynchronous backlinks export for the specified target. When the export is accepted, returns {task_id, task_status}; pass task_id to getBacklinksExportStatus to poll for the download URL. If the export is not accepted (for example, when the account export quota is exhausted), task_status is "rejected" and no task_id is returned — check task_status before reading task_id.

target.description: Aim of the request: root domain, host, or URL.

tools.name: DATA_getAiSearchBrand
tools.title: AI Search: Brand Resolution (SE Ranking)
tools.description: Data Tool: Identifies and returns the brand name SE Ranking attributes to a given target (root domain, subdomain, or URL) in AI search results. Useful for determining what brand name to pass to the other AI search tools.

target.description: The target to analyze. Can be a root domain, subdomain, or a specific URL.

scope.description: The scope of the analysis. Can be base_domain (aggregate by registrable domain, includes all subdomains), domain (exact host only, no subdomain aggregation), or url (exact URL including path and query).

source.description: Alpha-2 country code that scopes results to a regional database (e.g., us for United-States results).

tools.name: DATA_getAiSearchLeaderboard
tools.title: AI Search Comparison & Leaderboard (SE Ranking)
tools.description: Data Tool: Compare multiple domains/brands in AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, AI Overview, AI Mode). Use this for AI search comparison, competitor analysis, and visibility benchmarking. Returns brand presence, link presence, share of voice rankings, and leaderboard for each domain across AI engines.

target.description: Domain, subdomain, or URL to analyze.

brand.description: Brand name associated with this target.

primary.description: The primary target to analyze. Object with target (domain/subdomain/URL) and brand name.

target.description: Domain, subdomain, or URL to analyze.

brand.description: Brand name associated with this target.

competitors.description: Array of competitor targets to compare against. Each object has target and brand. Maximum 10 competitors.

source.description: Alpha-2 country code that scopes results to a regional database (e.g., us for United-States results).

engines.description: Array of AI engines to include in the analysis. Options: 'ai-overview', 'ai-mode', 'chatgpt', 'perplexity', 'gemini'.

scope.description: The scope of the analysis. Can be base_domain (domain and all subdomains), domain (specific host), or url (exact URL). Default: base_domain.

tools.name: DATA_getAiSearchOverview
tools.title: AI Search Overview (SE Ranking)
tools.description: Data Tool: AI search visibility metrics for a target. The summary block contains four metrics (brand_presence, link_presence, ai_opportunity_traffic, average_position) with period-over-period change. `view: 'time-series'` (default) additionally returns monthly trend streams for ai_traffic, organic_traffic, overall_traffic, link_presence, and average_position. Omit `engine` for aggregated metrics across all AI engines; pass one of the five engine values to query a single engine. Note: aggregated values are not the sum of per-engine values — the server applies its own aggregation. The monthly window is fixed; date-range, period, interval, limit, and scope filters are ignored.

target.description: The target to analyze. Root domain, subdomain, or URL.

source.description: Alpha-2 country code that scopes results to a regional database (e.g., us for United-States results).

view.description: 'current' = latest snapshot of the summary metrics only. 'time-series' (default) = same summary plus monthly trend streams. Defaults to 'time-series'.

engine.description: Scope to one AI engine. Omit for aggregated metrics across all engines.

brand.description: Brand name to attribute mentions to. If omitted, the server resolves a brand from the target.

tools.title: AI Search: Get Prompts by Brand (SE Ranking)
tools.description: Data Tool: Returns AI-search prompts where the specified brand name is mentioned. Provide a brand name (resolve one with getAiSearchBrand). If you have a domain or URL instead of a brand name, use getAiSearchPromptsByTarget.

engine.description: AI engine to query. One of: 'ai-overview', 'ai-mode', 'chatgpt', 'perplexity', 'gemini'.

brand.description: Brand name to search for in LLM snippets.

source.description: Alpha-2 country code that scopes results to a regional database (e.g., 'us').

sort.description: The field to sort the results by. Options: volume, type, snippet_length.

limit.description: Max prompts per page (1–1000). Default: 100.

offset.description: Starting index for pagination. Default: 0.

filter_volume_from.description: Specifies the minimum volume of searches to be included in the results.

filter_volume_to.description: Specifies the maximum volume of searches to be included in the results.

filter_keyword_count_from.description: Specifies the minimum number of words in prompts.

filter_keyword_count_to.description: Specifies the maximum number of words in prompts.

filter_characters_count_from.description: Specifies the minimum prompt length in characters.

filter_characters_count_to.description: Specifies the maximum prompt length in characters.

filter_multi_keyword_included.description: A URL-encoded JSON string specifying keywords that must be present in the prompt. For example: filter[multi_keyword_included]=[[{"type":"contains","value":"seo"},{"type":"contains","value":"tools"}],[{"type":"contains","value":"backlinks"}]]

filter_multi_keyword_excluded.description: A URL-encoded JSON string specifying keywords that must NOT be present in the prompt. For example: filter[multi_keyword_excluded]=[[{"type":"contains","value":"seo"},{"type":"contains","value":"tools"}],[{"type":"contains","value":"backlinks"}]]

annotations.title: AI Search: Get Prompts by Brand (SE Ranking)

tools.name: DATA_getAllBacklinks
tools.title: Backlinks — Filtered List
tools.description: Data Tool: Returns a filtered, sortable list of backlinks pointing to a target (up to 10,000). Each entry includes url_from, url_to, anchor, nofollow, and inlink_rank. Filter by inlink_rank, domain_inlink_rank, source/target URL, anchor text, and nofollow status; sort via order_by. Use when you want a specific slice of backlinks; to pull an entire backlink set in large batches, use getBacklinksRaw.

target.description: Target to analyze: root domain, host (subdomain), or full URL.

mode.description: Scope: 'domain' (incl. subdomains), 'host' (no subdomains), or 'url' (single URL). Default: host.

limit.description: Max results to return (1–10,000). Default: 100.

per_domain.description: Number of backlinks per referring domain to return. If omitted, returns all backlinks (may exceed 100).

url_from_filter.description: Substring to filter 'url_from' by (ASCII, max 2063 chars).

url_to_filter.description: Substring to filter 'url_to' by (ASCII, max 2063 chars).

anchor_filter.description: Substring to filter 'anchor' by (ASCII, max 2063 chars).

nofollow_filter.description: Backlink type filter: 'nofollow_only' or 'dofollow_only'. If omitted, returns all.

code.description: Unique code for the issue (e.g., title_duplicate).

limit.description: Number of URLs to return in the list.

offset.description: Starting position (offset) for the list of URLs.

tools.description: Data Tool: Checks the real-time status of a specific website audit, whether it’s queued, currently processing, or already finished.

audit_id.description: Unique identifier of the audit to check.

tools.title: Backlink Anchor Texts

target.description: Target to analyze: root domain, host (subdomain), or full URL.

mode.description: Scope: 'domain' (incl. subdomains), 'host' (no subdomains), or 'url' (single URL). Default: host.

tools.description: Data Tool: Returns the core backlink counts for one or many targets — backlinks, referring domains, subnets, IPs, and dofollow/nofollow/edu/gov backlink counts. target.description: Target to analyze: root domain, host (subdomain), or URL. Can be a single string or an array of strings for batch processing.

mode.description: Scope: 'domain' (incl. subdomains), 'host' (no subdomains), or 'url' (single URL). Default: host.

tools.title: Backlinks — Bulk Export (Paginated)
tools.description: Data Tool: Returns all backlinks pointing to a target in large pages (up to 100,000 per page) via a `next` cursor, with no filtering. Use to pull an entire backlink set in batches; for a filtered or sorted slice, use getAllBacklinks.

target.description: Target to analyze: root domain, host (subdomain), or URL.

mode.description: Scope: 'domain' (incl. subdomains), 'host' (no subdomains), or 'url' (single URL). Default: host.

limit.description: Max results per page (1-100,000). Default: 10,000.

next.description: Cursor for the next page of results. Do NOT include for the first request.

per_domain.description: Number of backlinks per referring domain to return. If omitted, returns all.

tools.name: DATA_getBacklinksRefDomains
tools.title: Referring Domains
tools.description: Data Tool: Retrieves a list of referring domains pointing to the specified target, with options for sorting and limiting results.

target.description: Target to analyze: root domain, host (subdomain), or full URL.

mode.description: Scope: 'domain' (incl. subdomains), 'host' (no subdomains), or 'url' (single URL). Default: host.

order_by.description: Sort field: 'date_found' (most recent first), 'domain_inlink_rank' (highest first), or 'inlink_rank' (homepage IR highest first).

limit.description: Max results to return (1–10,000). Default: 100.

tools.name: DATA_getBacklinksSummary
tools.title: Backlink Profile Summary
tools.description: Data Tool: Returns backlink-profile fields for one or many targets — counts plus authority (InLink Rank, Domain InLink Rank), home-page link counts, text-link totals, and referring-domain breakdowns. Use for an at-a-glance profile; for only the core counts, use getBacklinksMetrics. Supports batch requests.

target.description: Single target or an array of targets (root domain, host, or full URL). Required — pass an array to get one summary row per target in a single call.

mode.description: Scope of analysis: 'domain' (incl. all subdomains), 'host' (the exact host you pass, excluding sibling subdomains — e.g. blog.example.com stays blog.example.com; for an apex target, apex + www are folded as one host), or 'url' (single URL). Default: host.

tools.description: Data Tool: Returns a paginated list of all URLs found during an audit, providing a sitemap as discovered by the crawler. Page through results with limit and offset.

limit.description: Number of pages to return in the list.

offset.description: Starting position for the list of pages.

histogramMode.description: Mode of aggregation: domain (unique domains) or host (unique hosts).

tools.title: Domain Paid Ads
tools.description: Data Tool: Retrieves paid ads for a specific domain.

page.description: For paginated results, specifies the page number of paid-ad results for this domain to retrieve.

tools.title: Keyword Paid Ads

Use to see who advertises on a keyword and what their ad copy looks like. Results are paginated via page and limit.

source.description: Lowercase SE Ranking regional database code (e.g. us, uk, de, fr, es, br, ca, au). Note: SE Ranking uses uk (not gb) for the United Kingdom; the ISO code "gb" is accepted and auto-mapped to "uk".

keyword.description: The specific keyword for which to retrieve paid ad data.

from.description: The starting year and month for the data retrieval period, formatted as “YYYY-MM” (e.g., “2017-01”).

to.description: The ending year and month for the data retrieval period, formatted as “YYYY-MM”.

page.description: For paginated results, specifies the page number of domains advertising on this keyword to retrieve.

limit.description: The maximum number of domains (advertising on the keyword) to return per page.

tools.name: DATA_getDomainAuthority
tools.title: Get Domain Authority
tools.description: Data Tool: Returns information about the domain InLink Rank (Domain Authority) of the target page’s root domain.

target.description: Aim of the request: root domain, host, or URL.

tools.name: DATA_getDomainAuthorityHistory
tools.title: Get Domain Authority History
tools.description: Data Tool: Returns historical Domain InLink Rank (Domain Authority) values for a target domain. The target is always resolved to its PLD (pay-level domain) regardless of whether a root domain, host, or URL is provided.

target.description: Domain, host, or URL (PLD is extracted).

granularity.description: Granularity at which to return data: by_day, by_week, or by_month.

tools.name: DATA_getDomainCompetitors
tools.title: Domain Competitors
tools.description: Data Tool: Retrieves up to 500 competing domains (organic or paid) for a target domain. Each row includes common_keywords, domain_relevance, total_keywords, missing_keywords, traffic_sum, price_sum. Rows are returned in an unspecified/internal order — NOT sorted by common_keywords or domain_relevance — so sort client-side (e.g. by common_keywords descending) before treating data[0] as the top competitor. Upstream API does not support limit, offset, or custom sort — response size is fixed (~60KB / a few hundred rows for popular domains).

source.description: Lowercase SE Ranking regional database code (e.g. us, uk, de, fr, es, br, ca, au). Note: SE Ranking uses uk (not gb) for the United Kingdom; the ISO code "gb" is accepted and auto-mapped to "uk".

domain.description: The primary domain for which to find competitors.

type.description: Whether to return organic or paid-search (advertising) competitors.

tools.name: DATA_getDomainKeywords
tools.title: Domain Keywords
tools.description: Data Tool: Retrieves a list of keywords for which a domain ranks in organic or paid search.

source.description: Lowercase SE Ranking regional database code (e.g. us, uk, de, fr, es, br, ca, au). Note: SE Ranking uses uk (not gb) for the United Kingdom; the ISO code "gb" is accepted and auto-mapped to "uk".

domain.description: The domain name for which to retrieve keywords. Note: **when both `domain` and `url` are supplied, `url` takes precedence and `domain` is ignored**.

type.description: Specifies whether to retrieve keywords for organic search traffic or paid search (advertising) traffic.

order_field.description: The field by which the returned keyword list should be sorted.

page.description: For paginated results, specifies the page number to retrieve.

limit.description: The maximum number of keywords to return per page.

year.description: Year of the historical data snapshot to retrieve (e.g., 2024). Must be provided together with `month` — if either is omitted, the current snapshot is returned. Months with no available snapshot return an empty list. Historical responses use a different schema than current responses (see note on `month`).

month.description: Month (1-12) of the historical data snapshot to retrieve. Must be provided together with `year` — if either is omitted, the current snapshot is returned. Note: historical responses rename `prev_pos` to `previous_position`, return `volume` and `traffic` as strings instead of integers, return `intents` as long names (`"INFORMATIONAL"`) instead of short codes (`"I"`), and omit `total_sites` and `block_type`.

cols.description: A comma-separated list of specific response parameter names to include in the output. If omitted, a default set of relevant columns is returned.

pos_change.description: Filters keywords based on changes in their ranking positions compared to the previous period.

filter_volume_from.description: Specifies the minimum monthly search volume for keywords to be included.

filter_volume_to.description: Specifies the maximum monthly search volume for keywords to be included.

filter_difficulty_from.description: Specifies the minimum keyword difficulty score (typically 0-100) for keywords to be included.

filter_difficulty_to.description: Specifies the maximum keyword difficulty score for keywords to be included.

filter_keyword_count_from.description: Specifies the minimum number of words in a keyword phrase.

filter_keyword_count_to.description: Specifies the maximum number of words in a keyword phrase.

filter_intents.description: A comma-separated list of search intent codes to filter keywords.

filter_competition_from.description: Specifies the minimum competition score (typically 0-1 or 0-100, depending on the metric scale) for keywords.

filter_competition_to.description: Specifies the maximum competition score for keywords.

filter_cpc_from.description: Specifies the minimum Cost Per Click (CPC) value for keywords.

filter_cpc_to.description: Specifies the maximum Cost Per Click (CPC) value for keywords.

tools.description: Project Tool: Rename a project keyword group, identified by its group ID (from listKeywordGroups). Takes group_id and the new name; no project ID is required.

group_id.description: ID of the keyword group to update

tools.name: PROJECT_updateLlmEngine
tools.title: Update LLM Engine
tools.description: Project Tool: Partially update configuration of an LLM engine in AI Result Tracker (region_name and/or lang_code). A VALID canonical `region_name` is geocoded and stored on ALL engine types; an INVALID/abbreviated region is rejected with HTTP 400 on location-aware engines (google_ai_overview, google_ai_mode, gemini) but silently dropped (HTTP 200, region_name: null) on chatgpt/perplexity.

region_name.description: Canonical SERP location name (e.g. "Los Angeles, California, United States"). Must match exactly a value returned by PROJECT_getAvailableRegions. A valid canonical region is geocoded to lat/lng/uule (5 km radius) under `region_settings` on ALL engine types. An abbreviated/invalid form (e.g. "Los Angeles, CA, USA") is rejected with HTTP 400 "Invalid region name. Please use a valid canonical location name." on location-aware engines (google_ai_overview, google_ai_mode, gemini), but silently dropped (HTTP 200, region_name: null) on chatgpt/perplexity. Set to null to clear.

lang_code.description: Language code (e.g. "es"). Set to null to clear.

tools.name: PROJECT_updatePlanTask
tools.title: Update Marketing Plan Task
tools.description: Project Tool: Update an existing marketing plan task title and description.

tools.name: PROJECT_updateProject
tools.title: Update Project
tools.description: Project Tool: Requires a project ID. Change/update project settings.

subdomain_match.description: Take subdomains in SERPs into account

check_day.description: Day of week (1-7) or day of month (1-31)

tools.name: PROJECT_updateProjectGroup
tools.title: Update Project Group
tools.description: Project Tool: Rename a project group, identified by its group ID (from listProjectGroups). Takes group_id and the new name; no project ID is required.

group_id.description: ID of the project group to rename

tools.name: PROJECT_updatePromptGroup
tools.title: Rename Prompt Group
tools.description: Project Tool: Rename an AI Result Tracker prompt group.

tools.name: PROJECT_updateSearchEngine
tools.title: Update Search Engine
tools.description: Project Tool: Partially update a search engine already attached to a project. Identify the engine by its project-local `site_engine_id` (returned by `addSearchEngine` / `getSearchEngines`), not the global `search_engine_id`.

site_id.description: Project ID the engine belongs to (returned by createProject / listProjects).

site_engine_id.description: Project-local search engine ID (the value returned as `site_engine_id` by addSearchEngine / getSearchEngines). NOT the global `search_engine_id`.

region_name.description: Canonical sub-country target string for Google (e.g. "New York, New York, United States"). Must match exactly a value returned by PROJECT_getAvailableRegions — abbreviated forms are rejected. Pass to change the geo target; omit to leave unchanged.

lang_code.description: ISO 639-1 language code (e.g. "en", "de", "fr"). Full catalogue via PROJECT_getGoogleLanguages. Pass to change the language; omit to leave unchanged.

merge_map.description: Take Google Maps SERPs into account. 0 – don’t take into account, 1 – take into account, 2 – take into account and display separately.

business_name.description: Business name for Google Maps SERPs

phone.description: Company phone number for Google Maps SERPs

paid_results.description: Track rankings in Google Ads (1 – yes, 0 – no)

featured_snippet.description: Take Featured snippet into account (1 – take into account, 0 – don’t take into account)

tools.name: PROJECT_updateSubAccount
tools.title: Update Sub-Account
tools.description: Project Tool: Edit an existing sub-account's settings, limits, and permissions. Omitted scalar fields (email, name, language, limits) are left unchanged (partial update); but the `access` array, when provided, REPLACES the entire permission set (see that field).

access.description: Array of permission codes that REPLACES the sub-account's entire permission set — NOT additive. A partial array drops every permission not included; an empty array [] clears all permissions. Read current permissions via getSubAccountDetails first and pass the complete desired set. Only valid SE Ranking permission codes are stored — unrecognized codes are silently dropped.

tools.name: PROJECT_updateUrlTags
tools.title: Update URL Tags
tools.description: Project Tool: Requires a project ID (site_id). Changes which tags are attached to the given URLs and/or domains — this is NOT an additive "add tags" call. For each submitted URL/domain: if it currently has NO tags, the submitted tag_ids are attached; if it already has one or more tags, the submitted tag_ids are detached from it. Submitting a tag that is already attached therefore REMOVES it, and existing tag associations can be lost (not recoverable). To attach a tag additively, use addTag instead; call listTags first to inspect current assignments.

tools.name: SEV_addBrandAliases
tools.title: Add SE Visible Brand Aliases
tools.description: SE Visible Tool: Add one or more aliases to an existing brand (works for both the primary brand and competitors). Each alias title must be unique within the project and not match any existing brand or alias. To replace/clear the whole alias set instead, use SEV_updateBrand.

aliases.description: Alias titles to add. Each unique within the project, max 500 characters.

tools.name: SEV_createBrand
tools.title: Add SE Visible Competitor Brand
tools.description: SE Visible Tool: Add a competitor brand to a project, with a domain and optional aliases. Brands created here are always competitors (is_primary: false); the primary brand is set at project creation. The title must be unique within the project.

title.description: Brand title. Unique within the project. Max 500 characters.

domain.description: Brand domain URL, including protocol. Max 500 characters.

aliases.description: Optional alias titles (sub-brands). Each unique within the project, max 500 characters.

tools.name: SEV_createProject
tools.title: Create SE Visible Project
tools.description: SE Visible Tool: Create a project that tracks a brand's visibility across AI assistants. Processing is asynchronous: the response returns the new project UUID immediately, before any results are ready — poll SEV_getProject until project.status is "success" and check.processed_percent is 100.

domain.description: Target domain URL to analyze, including protocol (e.g. https://lavazza.com).

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for project context. One of: US, UK, CA, FR, DE, NL, ES, AT, BE, AU, NZ, IT, JP, KR, SG, IN, AE, BR, MX, CH, DK, SE, NO, FI, IE, IS, LU, PT, HK, TH, MY, ID, PH, IL, AR, CL, CO, ZA, CZ, GR, TR, PL.

lang_code.description: ISO 639-1 language code for project context. One of: en, fr, de, nl, es, it, ja, ko, hi, ar, pt, da, sv, nb, fi, ga, is, lb, zh, th, ms, id, tl, he, af, cs, el, tr, pl.

brand_names.description: Brand names to track, including variations and aliases (at least one).

topics.description: Topics to group prompts under (at least one).

tools.name: SEV_createPrompts
tools.title: Create SE Visible Prompts
tools.description: SE Visible Tool: Create one or more prompts under a topic. The prompts are added to the given topic and start being processed against the project's AI models. Returns the created prompt IDs.

prompts.description: Prompt texts to create (at least one).

tools.name: SEV_createTopics
tools.title: Create SE Visible Topics
tools.description: SE Visible Tool: Create one or more topics in a project. Topics group related prompts so you can organise what you track and slice metrics by theme. Returns the created topics. (There is no separate list-topics call — read topics via SEV_getProject.)

titles.description: Topic titles to create (at least one, each non-empty).

tools.name: SEV_deleteBrand
tools.title: Delete SE Visible Brand
tools.description: SE Visible Tool: Delete a competitor brand and all its aliases. The primary brand cannot be deleted (returns 422 "Cannot delete the primary brand"). Returns 204 No Content on success.

tools.name: SEV_deleteProject
tools.title: Delete SE Visible Project
tools.description: SE Visible Tool: Soft-delete a project from the organisation. The project is removed from active use but can be restored. Returns 204 No Content on success.

tools.name: SEV_deletePrompts
tools.title: Delete SE Visible Prompts
tools.description: SE Visible Tool: Delete one or more prompts from a project in a single request. Returns 204 No Content on success.

prompt_ids.description: IDs of the prompts to delete (from SEV_listPrompts).

tools.name: SEV_deleteTopic
tools.title: Delete SE Visible Topic
tools.description: SE Visible Tool: Delete a topic AND all prompts grouped under it. This removes the prompts and their results — move prompts out first with SEV_movePrompts if you want to keep them. Returns 204 No Content on success.

tools.name: SEV_getBrandMetrics
tools.title: SE Visible Brand Metrics
tools.description: SE Visible Tool: Aggregated brand visibility metrics for dynamic table rendering. Choose how rows are grouped (dimensions, 1-3 — the LAST dimension is the pivot/columns) and which metrics to return (1-5). With 1 dimension the response is flat rows; with 2-3, meta.columns.dynamic lists the pivot IDs and each row gains {pivotId}_{metric} keys (null where no data). Supply a compare period (compare_date_from/compare_date_to) to get deltas.

dimensions.description: Row grouping, 1-3, no duplicates. The last dimension is the pivot. Values: topic_id, brand_id, prompt_id.

metrics.description: Metrics to return, 1-5. Values: visibility_score, avg_position, sentiment_score, total_mentions, rank, total_response_count, positive_pct, neutral_pct, negative_pct, total_all_mentions, unique_brands_count, share_of_voice.

compare_date_from.description: Optional compare period start, YYYY-MM-DD. Supply both compare_* to enable compare mode (returns deltas).

model_types.description: Filter by AI model types. One or more of: chatgpt, google_gemini, perplexity, google_ai_mode, google_ai_overview.

country_codes.description: Filter by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes.

sentiments.description: Filter by sentiment. One or more of: positive, neutral, negative.

sort_field.description: Metric name or pivot expression metric_name[dimension=value] (e.g. visibility_score[brand_id=12]). Default: first metric, descending.

limit.description: Max items to return. Default 50.

offset.description: Items to skip (pagination). Default 0.

tools.name: SEV_getProject
tools.title: Get SE Visible Project
tools.description: SE Visible Tool: Get one project in detail — metadata, check processing progress (check.processed_percent), the topics being tracked (with prompt counts), available historical check dates, the next scheduled check, and the competitor brands attached. Poll this to track asynchronous processing after SEV_createProject.

tools.name: SEV_getPrompt
tools.title: Get SE Visible Prompt
tools.description: SE Visible Tool: Get the details of a single prompt — id, text, topic_id, created_at, and is_parsed.

tools.name: SEV_getPromptResult
tools.title: Get SE Visible Prompt Result
tools.description: SE Visible Tool: Get the full detail of a single result — the complete AI response text, the source URLs cited, the brands mentioned, sentiment, average position, and the model that produced it. Use SEV_getPromptResultDump for the raw unmodified LLM response.

tools.name: SEV_getPromptResultDump
tools.title: SE Visible Raw LLM Response
tools.description: SE Visible Tool: Download the raw, unmodified LLM response for a result, exactly as the provider returned it. The body is text/html (not JSON) — returned here as a text/html resource plus a short note. Use it to compare the original response against the parsed result from SEV_getPromptResult.

tools.name: SEV_getSources
tools.title: SE Visible Sources
tools.description: SE Visible Tool: The domains and URLs that AI models cited across a project — the citation layer of SE Visible. source_type='domain' (default) returns one row per cited domain; source_type='url' returns one row per cited page (and changes which source_sort_field values are valid). Most numeric fields come back as metric objects with a values array; supplying a compare period adds a delta. A base date range is required.

compare_date_from.description: Optional compare period start, YYYY-MM-DD. Supply both compare_* to enable compare mode (returns deltas).

source_type.description: Row shape: 'domain' (default) or 'url'. Also sets which source_sort_field values are valid.

model_types.description: Filter by AI model types. One or more of: chatgpt, google_gemini, perplexity, google_ai_mode, google_ai_overview.

country_codes.description: Filter by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes.

sentiments.description: Filter by sentiment. One or more of: positive, neutral, negative.

search_query.description: Substring filter on the domain or URL.

domain_id.description: Restrict results to a single domain (domain_id from a domain row).

types.description: Filter by URL category type. One or more of: file, video, social, forum, q&a, documentation, wiki, news, blog, product, job, educational, local, app, search, homepage, other.

is_my_brand_mentions.description: Filter by whether the project's primary brand is mentioned: 1 mentioned, 0 not mentioned, -1 status unavailable.

competitors_count_from.description: Minimum number of competitor brands on the source (inclusive).

competitors_count_to.description: Maximum number of competitor brands on the source (inclusive).

brand_ids.description: Keep sources mentioning these brand IDs (see brand_match_mode).

brand_match_mode.description: When filtering by brand_ids: match 'any' (default) or 'all' of the brands.

source_sort_field.description: Field to sort by; the valid set depends on source_type. domain: ai_answers_count, pages, coverage, prompts_count, mention_rate, my_brand_mentions_count, competitors_count, first_seen, last_seen. url: ai_answers_count, coverage, prompts_count, competitors_count, my_brand_mentions, gap_score, first_seen, last_seen, last_check_date. Passing a value outside the set for the current source_type returns 422.

limit.description: Max items to return. Default 1000, max 10000.

offset.description: Items to skip (pagination). Default 0.

tools.name: SEV_getSubscription
tools.title: SE Visible Subscription
tools.description: SE Visible Tool: Get the organisation SE Visible plan and its current usage limits — plan key, status, billing period, renewal, and the max/used/available counts for projects, prompts, and user seats. SE Visible usage is governed by these plan limits, not per-request credits.

tools.name: SEV_listBrands
tools.title: List SE Visible Brands
tools.description: SE Visible Tool: List a project's tracked brands — the primary brand (is_primary: true, listed first) and competitors — each with its domain and aliases. Use SEV_listMentionedBrands to discover brands the AI models mentioned but that you do not yet track.

tools.name: SEV_listMentionedBrands
tools.title: List SE Visible Mentioned Brands
tools.description: SE Visible Tool: List every brand the AI models mentioned in a project's check results. These are distinct from the brands you manually track (SEV_listBrands) and are useful for discovering competitors to add via SEV_createBrand.

tools.name: SEV_listProjects
tools.title: List SE Visible Projects
tools.description: SE Visible Tool: List every SE Visible project in the authenticated user's organisation. Each project includes its UUID, domain, tracked brand names, status (queued/processing/success/error), creation and last-checked timestamps, and the AI models it runs against.

tools.name: SEV_listPromptResults
tools.title: List SE Visible Prompt Results
tools.description: SE Visible Tool: List the results for a prompt — one item per model run, with the model's text, the top brands it mentioned, sentiment, average position, and flags for URLs/mentions. Use SEV_getPromptResult for the full text, source URLs, and brand list of a single result. A base date range is required.

compare_date_from.description: Optional compare period start, YYYY-MM-DD. Supply both compare_* to enable compare mode (returns deltas).

model_types.description: Filter by AI model types. One or more of: chatgpt, google_gemini, perplexity, google_ai_mode, google_ai_overview.

sentiments.description: Filter by sentiment. One or more of: positive, neutral, negative.

limit.description: Max items to return. Default 1000.

offset.description: Items to skip (pagination). Default 0.

tools.name: SEV_listPrompts
tools.title: List SE Visible Prompts
tools.description: SE Visible Tool: List a project's prompts with their visibility metrics (group_mode='prompt', default), or topics with metrics aggregated across their prompts (group_mode='topic'). The response schema differs between the two modes. A base date range is required.

group_mode.description: What to list: 'prompt' (one row per prompt, default) or 'topic' (topics with aggregated metrics).

compare_date_from.description: Optional compare period start, YYYY-MM-DD. Supply both compare_* to enable compare mode (returns deltas).

model_types.description: Filter by AI model types. One or more of: chatgpt, google_gemini, perplexity, google_ai_mode, google_ai_overview.

country_codes.description: Filter by ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes.

sentiments.description: Filter by sentiment. One or more of: positive, neutral, negative.

search_query.description: Substring filter on the prompt text.

sort_field.description: Field to sort by. One of: visibility, avg_position, mentions, sentiments.

limit.description: Max items to return. Default 1000.

offset.description: Items to skip (pagination). Default 0.

tools.name: SEV_movePrompts
tools.title: Move SE Visible Prompts
tools.description: SE Visible Tool: Move prompts to a target topic. Select the prompts by their IDs (prompt_ids), by their source topics (topic_ids — ALL prompts in those topics are moved), or both (the set is deduplicated). At least one of prompt_ids or topic_ids is required. Atomic; the target topic must belong to the same project. Returns 204 No Content on success.

topic_id.description: Target topic ID the prompts are moved to.

prompt_ids.description: IDs of individual prompts to move.

topic_ids.description: IDs of source topics whose prompts should ALL be moved.

tools.name: SEV_updateBrand
tools.title: Update SE Visible Brand
tools.description: SE Visible Tool: Update a brand's domain and/or sync its aliases. When aliases is provided it REPLACES all existing aliases (new added, existing kept, absent removed); pass an empty array to clear all aliases; omit it to leave aliases untouched. Both fields are optional.

aliases.description: Alias titles to sync (replaces existing). Pass [] to clear all aliases; omit to leave unchanged.

tools.name: SEV_updateTopic
tools.title: Rename SE Visible Topic
tools.description: SE Visible Tool: Rename a topic. The project's default topic cannot be updated. Returns the updated topic.
